topics.summary: US men’s storefront pagination and exposed product collections; one lowest-price qualifying color with any-size availability per collection/name selection (or a labeled unavailable color when none is available; team/graphic names retained separately). Repeated names can occur across retailer collections; cards are not a count of distinct designs. Other natural colors are linked in Sources & evidence; only the selected color gallery is mirrored. No preferred-size or color exclusion.
